lead_raw_text:
The structure of Co4Cr4Te8 (reduced formula CoCrTe2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 16 atoms per unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Cr each adopt octahedral coordination by six Te neighbors, while Te centers have six geometric neighbors (two Co and four Cr). The Co and Cr octahedra share corners and edges, and Co–Cr octahedra share edges, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
